synopsis: In the urban civilization floating in space, "Cocoon", lived four students of the United Nations University: Arata, Tara, Caesar, and Louis. These four were a new breed of human, who had undergone the process of neoteny and adapted to the space age. The entirety of human relationships are decided by contracts, and while some humans get to live for hundreds of years, others are not quite so lucky. One day, these four meet a girl with green hair in the red light district, and thus our story begins.

title: Ohten no Mon: Gate of Secrets
titleEnglish: Ohten no Mon: Gate of Secrets
synopsis: Set in the Heian era, when the Fujiwara clan schemed to seize power at the Imperial Court, a court lady's mysterious disappearance suddenly occurs in the capital. Tasked by the Emperor, who fears it may be the work of the oni, Ariwara no Narihira encounters a young man named Sugawara no Michizane. This unlikely pair - the reclusive student Michizane and the famously charming Narihira, separated by class, birth, and nearly 20 years in age - team up to unravel the bizarre cases in Kyoto! From the rising talent Yak Haibara of "Kaiyu no mori"(Walks in the Woods) and "SP"(Security Police) comes a Heian-period crime suspense manga! (Source: Emaqi)

synopsis: My peaceful school life... is officially over. Izumiya Ryouta, an introverted otaku, suddenly finds himself surrounded by the top three beauties of the class after a seat change. In front of him sits the little-sister-type Miyama Airi. To his left, the cool and detached gyaru, Ichinose Yuria. And to his right, the refined, black-haired class rep, Kuroki Ruri. On the surface, they're flawless beauties—but Ryouta stumbles upon secrets that none of them can ever let out... "P-Please...! Just don't tell anyone about this!" "From now on, we're in that kind of relationship." "This is a secret... just between you and me, Ryouta-kun." All he wanted was a quiet otaku life—so how did things end up like this?! Caught between three troublesome girls, an introverted otaku desperately fights to avoid any more chaos in this love-comedy showdown! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: His name is Itou Hiroyuki, nickname: Hiro-kun. He's a math teacher at the private Taihei Academy, as well as the homeroom teacher of class 3-3. 1000 Yen Hero
synopsis: “I won't become a hero even if I am poor, because as long as Honoka continues to smile, it's all worth it.” Monsters are on the loose! But luckily for the people of Japan, heroes are there to protect them, with powers that run on a rate of yen per second. For Hiasa Sen, however, there are many more important things to worry about, like catching sales on groceries, and his many part-time jobs, all to take care of his little sister. When danger approaches, however, he has a secret power of his own, but it may be more trouble than it's worth. (Source: Comikey)

title: NonNonBa
synonyms: Non Non Ba
Nonnonba
synopsis: Autobiographical tale in which Mizuki narrates the memories of his childhood in the decade of 1930, in Sakaiminato, a small coastal town at the southwest Japan. With nostalgia and tenderness, the mangaka narrates his first years of life within a modest family, the fights with his friends,the school and his first loves. The title character of the book, NonNonBa, is an old mystical and superstitious woman by which Shigeru discovers the world of yokai, supernatural beings and grotesque bestiary of medieval Japanese. Won Best Album at the 2007 Angoulême International Comics Festival.

synopsis: "Don’t you think it’s stupid to be so madly in love?" Princess Letitia is due to be executed by guillotine, for the terrible crimes she committed trying to win back her fiancee's love. However, just when she thought she was dead, she was returned back in time for a second chance at life. "I won’t fall in love in my new life. I’m going to live peacefully by becoming a sober, hard-working student with glasses!” But one day, her glasses slip off and Camilo, the school's superstar, sees her true face. Then, for some reason, Camilo begins to dote on her in a tidal wave of affection…!? (Source: Comic Days, translated)

synopsis: What would an ultra-rational Japanese salaryman do if he was reborn as a girl in a world where magic was real? Obviously, become the Empire's most feared magic soldier, while climbing the army career ladder at the ripe old age of nine. But Tanya isn't about to let artillery shells or deadly spells stop her when a cushy desk job is calling! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Agnes Kamen
synonyms: Agunesu Kamen
synopsis: Professional wrestler Yamamoto Jingo just returned to Japan from a 5 year training trip in the US and Mexico, only to be greeted by his now defunct wrestling company: Yamato. He's come to find out that as soon as the president of the company passed away, the rival wrestling group "Teijitsu" took down Yamato. Jingo has now been forced to go seek revenge for the destruction of Yamato by challenging the Teijitsu president. One thing led to another, and now Jingo has been half-forced into working under Teijitsu as the new wrestler from Brazil: Agnes Kamen. (Source: MangaHelpers)

synonyms: Gloomy Neighbor at the Standing Bar
synopsis: Seiya Tonami is an office worker in his late twenties. His Friday night routine involves relaxing with a drink, alone at his favorite standing bar. But one day, after coming to the rescue of a college girl who was getting unwelcome attention at the bar, he finds himself sitting next to her every week. From small-talk about daily life to lighthearted complaints… Even though it's just casual conversation, it's so nice to have someone beside you, having a laugh together — it's a romantic comedy that makes you look forward to those Friday nights at the bar, where you feel free to get a little tipsy. (Source: Manga UP!, translated)
